description: Carnegie Supernova Project II (CSP-II) natural-system passbands from the CSP team: scans of the Swope telescope with the e2v CCD (u g r i B V) and of the du Pont telescope with RetroCam (Y J H), including the atmosphere.
notes: Curves are the CSP-II files linked one by one from the CSP filters page (not in CSP_filter_package.tgz), built by sed_tools.component_sources.csp. The optical file names carry the 'atm_ext_1.2' (airmass 1.2) label; the NIR files say only 'atm'. The page says the CSP-II filters 'will be described more fully in an upcoming publication' and cites Phillips et al. (2019) for colour terms. They are original-source curves, so no SVO record is attached (svo_filterID null). No licence, usage terms or acknowledgement request was found on the CSP filters page.

licence.terms: No licence or usage terms are stated on the CSP filters page or in the CSP_filter_package.tgz README (checked 2026-10-26); the page's footer covers only the Plone software.
